mapper.insert: insert into production_order (order_no, request_no, product_id, product_quantity, warehouse_id, retry_count, fail_reason, next_retry_time, status, is_del, create_time, update_time) values (#{orderNo}, #{requestNo}, #{productId}, #{productQuantity}, #{warehouseId}, #{retryCount}, #{failReason}, #{nextRetryTime}, #{status}, #{isDel}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select id, order_no, request_no, product_id, product_quantity, warehouse_id, retry_count, fail_reason, next_retry_time, status, is_del, create_time, update_time from production_order where id = #{id} and is_del = 0

select id, order_no, request_no, product_id, product_quantity, warehouse_id, retry_count, fail_reason, next_retry_time, status, is_del, create_time, update_time from production_order where request_no = #{requestNo} limit 1

select id, order_no, request_no, product_id, product_quantity, warehouse_id, retry_count, fail_reason, next_retry_time, status, is_del, create_time, update_time from production_order where status in (0, 3) and (next_retry_time is null or next_retry_time <= now()) and is_del = 0 order by id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update production_order set status = #{status}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_del = 0

update production_order set retry_count = retry_count + 1, fail_reason = #{failReason}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, status = case when retry_count + 1 >= #{maxRetryCount} then 4 else 3 end, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status in (0, 1, 3) and is_del = 0
